copy.tagline: 自动管理 ClickUp 项目任务、空间和团队操作
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常在 ClickUp 中手动创建和更新任务
copy.tagline_en: Automate ClickUp project tasks, spaces, and team operations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently create and update tasks in ClickUp manually

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能通过 Rube MCP 自动管理 ClickUp 项目，包括创建和更新任务、浏览工作区层级、添加评论、管理团队成员，以及按条件筛选任务。
howto.when: 当你要求创建、更新或查询 ClickUp 任务，或者需要浏览工作区、文件夹、列表结构时触发。

say.text: 把“设计首页”任务的状态改为“进行中”，并指派给张三。
say.note: Claude 会更新任务状态和负责人。

say.text: 列出“市场部”空间下所有未完成的任务。
say.note: Claude 会遍历层级并筛选任务。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automate ClickUp project management via Rube MCP, including creating and updating tasks, navigating workspace hierarchy, adding comments, managing team members, and filtering tasks by criteria.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create, update, or query ClickUp tasks, or need to browse workspace, folder, and list structures.

say_en.text: Create a new task in the 'Development' list titled 'Fix login page bug'.
say_en.note: Claude will find the workspace and list, then create the task.

say_en.text: Change the status of 'Design homepage' task to 'In Progress' and assign it to John.
say_en.note: Claude will update the task status and assignee.

say_en.text: List all incomplete tasks under the 'Marketing' space.
say_en.note: Claude will traverse the hierarchy and filter tasks.
